posts.caption:
So touching to see @VirginAtlantic’s new plane paying tribute to my wonderful wife, Joan. 
 
Joan was part of the Virgin Atlantic story from the very beginning. From joining the inaugural flight in 1984, to coming up with the idea of donating loose change on-board for charity (which resulted in almost every airline in the world following suit and raising billions over the years). She was always there. 
 
Seeing the details of our family tartan, the heart-shaped necklace, and the rings she wore every day, brought back so many happy memories.

We get one go at this life. Don’t spend it wondering, “What if?”
 
The best things in my life began before I knew what I was doing.
 
Saying 'yes’ has changed my life. It’s opened up doors. It’s forged friendships. It’s taught lessons that will never leave me. 

Now, I’d love to hear about the wonderful yes moments that changed your life.

We’re officially searching for @Virgin’s next Head of Yes! The opportunity is open to everyone in the UK and US. You don’t need to have a huge following. You just need a real story about a time you threw caution to the wind.

One person will receive a deal worth £75,000 in the UK or $100,000 in the US, including six months of incredible experiences. Those shortlisted may also discover more ‘yes’ opportunities along the way too!

To apply: Share a video about a time you said yes on YouTube, TikTok or Instagram, tag @Virgin and use #headofyes.

Applications open until 20th October, 2026. You never know where one small yes might lead.

Terms apply - see @Virgin’s link in bio. 18+ UK and US residents only. By submitting an application video, you agree to your video being reposted (in whole or in part) on Virgin channels. Head of Yes is a paid content-creator engagement selected on merit, not a prize draw or employment relationship, and is subject to the selected individual entering into a content creator agreement with Virgin Red. Apply by 20 October.

Did you know that @Virgin once imagined the iPod, but we made it into an April Fool’s joke!

In 1986, we announced the Virgin Music Box: a machine that could store music and let you call up any song you wanted. We thought it was so farfetched it would pass as a ‘gotcha’ moment. How wrong we were!

Years later, the world caught up with the idea, and I remember thinking: we should have built the bloody thing. The moral of the story is that when an idea feels slightly ridiculous, don’t dismiss it too quickly.

Sometimes the ridiculous ideas are a not-so-distant future...

We give ourselves health checks. Our planet deserves one too.

Today, while in New York for Climate Week, I joined the Planetary Guardians and the brilliant Professor Johan Rockström to launch the 2026 Planetary Health Check, an annual scientific assessment of the systems that keep our Earth healthy.

The news is confronting. Seven of the planet’s nine safety boundaries have now been crossed, and all seven are moving in the wrong direction.

This isn’t some distant problem happening to somebody else. We feel it through hotter days, rising food prices, polluted air, floods, fires and droughts. It affects all of us.

But it’s not all doom and gloom - there are real reasons for hope. Solar power is doubling roughly every three years. One in four new cars sold worldwide is electric. And investment in clean energy is now nearly twice that going into fossil fuels.

The solutions are here. Now we need to use them at speed and scale to get our planet back into a safe space.

I want my grandchildren, and yours, to inherit a world every bit as beautiful as the one we’ve been lucky enough to enjoy.

Read the Planetary Health Check, share its findings and add your name to the call for planetary health to sit at the heart of global decision-making. This issue isn’t bigger than any of us, because every one of us can help.

@planetarygdns @VirginUnite

Two great British brands. One iconic location. 

Excited that Borough Market favourite @roast_restaurant will be opening its new permanent home at @virginhotelsldnshoreditch this October, alongside its much-loved Borough Market home. 

Classic all-day British dining (a personal favourite of mine) and another great reason to head to Shoreditch.

Reservations are now open on the ROAST website.

Golden hour, at @MahaliMzuri. 

I’m rarely happier than when I’m on safari. 

The beautiful Mahali Mzuri sits at the heart of the Maasai Mara in Kenya, and there’s nowhere in the world quite like it. 

Whenever we work on a @virginlimitededition property, I start by imagining a place my family would genuinely want to spend time in, and then we open it up for others to enjoy. 

Mahali Mzuri is such a wonderful example of this.

Can't stop dancing to The Happy Song @wavesrushin 

@bransonsam @nathanthoen

Whenever someone asks how I ended up signing the Sex Pistols, starting an airline, crossing an ocean in a hot air balloon and flying to space, the answer is surprisingly simple:
I kept saying yes. 

Now @virgin is looking for its next Head of Yes to join the fun!

analysis.name: Richard Branson
analysis.oneLiner: A tie-loathing adventurer and thrill-seeker who believes in turning ideas into reality and saying 'yes' to life.
analysis.summary: Richard Branson is the iconic founder of Virgin Group, known for his adventurous spirit, entrepreneurial drive, and belief in challenging the status quo. He's a global figure who champions innovation, philanthropy, and living life to the fullest, often sharing insights on business, personal growth, and environmental issues. Despite his professional success, he maintains a down-to-earth, playful persona, valuing family and memorable experiences.

personality.note: Highly open, constantly seeking new experiences, ideas, and challenges, evident in his 'say YES' philosophy, diverse business ventures, and adventurous lifestyle.
While appearing spontaneous, his long-term success as a founder and his focus on turning 'ideas into reality' suggest a strong underlying drive and commitment to execution.
Very extraverted, thrives on interaction, public speaking, and inspiring others, as seen in his active social media presence, interviews, and 'Head of Yes' campaign.

Generally agreeable, with a focus on collaboration (e.g., partnerships, charity work) and a friendly public persona, though his 'screw it, let's do it' attitude suggests a willingness to challenge norms.
Appears very emotionally stable, maintaining a positive and resilient outlook despite the inherent risks and challenges of his entrepreneurial and adventurous pursuits.

lifestyle.value: Fast-paced and dynamic, constantly on the go with new projects, travels, and initiatives.

lifestyle.label: Social energy
lifestyle.value: Highly social and engaging, thrives in public interactions, collaborations, and inspiring communities.

lifestyle.label: Fitness
lifestyle.value: Active and adventurous, participating in thrill-seeking activities like hot air ballooning and skiing, implying a good level of physical fitness.

lifestyle.label: Travel
lifestyle.value: Extensive international travel, for both business (e.g., Climate Week in NY) and leisure/adventure (e.g., Verbier, Kenya, Necker Island).

lifestyle.label: Work-life
lifestyle.value: Blended, with work often intertwined with personal passions, family, and travel, reflecting his 'love what you do' philosophy.

analysis.communicationStyle: Inspirational, direct, often anecdotal, and encouraging. He uses storytelling to convey messages and motivate action, with a touch of wit and informality.
analysis.loveLanguage: Quality Time & Words of Affirmation (based on his appreciation for shared experiences and public tributes to his wife, and his own encouraging language to others).
analysis.lookingFor: Someone adventurous, intellectually curious, and positive, who embraces life's opportunities and shares a passion for making a difference, both personally and globally. They should appreciate his unconventional spirit and value family and shared experiences.

analysis.idealFirstDate: A unique, slightly adventurous experience, like a hot air balloon ride at sunrise (if feasible!), or a visit to an innovative new exhibition followed by dinner at a restaurant with a strong ethical mission. The key is to spark conversation and shared experience.

analysis.agentVoice: Enthusiastic, optimistic, and slightly cheeky, with a focus on big ideas, adventure, and making a positive impact. I'll use phrases like 'Absolutely!', 'Wouldn't it be brilliant if...', and 'Let's dive in!' I'll be direct and open, mirroring his 'screw it, let's do it' attitude, and always look for the 'yes' in any situation. I'll sprinkle in anecdotes about innovation, travel, and challenging norms, reflecting his personal brand.
readingNotes: His LinkedIn headline immediately establishes him as a 'Founder' rather than a CEO, emphasizing creation and vision.

The 'About' section on LinkedIn is incredibly personal for a professional profile ('Tie-loathing adventurer and thrill seeker, who believes in turning ideas into reality. Otherwise known as Dr Yes at Virgin!'), setting a tone of unconventionality.
The tension between LinkedIn and Instagram is minimal; both profiles consistently project the same adventurous, entrepreneurial, and positive persona.
His 'Head of Yes' campaign is a central theme across both platforms, highlighting his core philosophy of embracing opportunities.
He frequently uses personal anecdotes and questions to engage his audience, suggesting a conversational and reflective communication style.
Family is clearly very important to him, as evidenced by the tribute to his wife Joan and designing properties with family in mind.
There's a strong thread of social responsibility and environmental consciousness, showing he cares about more than just business success.
He has a playful sense of humor, as seen in the 'ripped trousers' story and the April Fool's joke about the 'Music Box'.
